run_sacred_experiment: run a sacred experiment that prints a configurable message using add_config and automain
create_sacred_experiment: create a sacred Experiment instance to manage a configurable hello world experiment
add_config_dict: add a configuration dictionary with a message key to a sacred experiment using add_config
override_config_with_cli: override the experiment message config using the sacred with command-line argument
decorate_automain: decorate a main function with ex.automain to auto-run it as the sacred experiment entry point
